en_before: An aesthetic is more than a palette. These three systems illustrate contrasting ways of organizing an outfit: Preppy uses collegiate references and garment structure; Sporty Chic uses sports-inspired pieces and movement-oriented combinations; Techwear assesses functional materials, storage and weather protection rather than assuming a technical appearance proves performance.
